# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: Leadfeeder remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the vendor's repository (Leadfeeder/leadfeeder-mcp-plugin at cddf27f).
- The vendor names its server `Leadfeeder`. This plugin uses `leadfeeder`.
- The vendor repository is Apache-2.0. See the License section.
